name: JK Joku Shojo ~Junsui na Kokoro no Mochinushi Hodo Shojo o Konomu to Iu Housoku~
original_name: ＪＫ辱処女 ～純粋な心の持ち主ほど処女を好むという法則～
source:
“Finally, I met the ideal girl.” 

The protagonist met Tougou Reia and ended up having sex with her.
At first, Reia was shy, but as they fucked more, she became bolder.
This was a belated youth for him, who had already passed thirty. 

“I want to try this next time.”

He was supposed to be teaching the virgin Reia, but before he knew it, she was teaching him stuff.
Sure, the current situation was enjoyable. But he couldn’t shake the feeling that this wasn’t good enough.
What should he do?..
